messages:
alex (support): Customer ThermoTech reports invoice INV-2026-0042 doesn't show their order id — payment went through yesterday but AP can't match. Need guidance on reissue vs quick patch.
marta (billing): Do we have the payment/charge id and whether it was captured? If captured we'll need a credit/refund + new invoice.
alex (support): Payment id pay_3K7b2c captured 2026-03-15T14:22Z. Portal PDF has an empty Order ID field; raw invoice metadata shows order_ref=null.
ryan (engineering): Quick triage — portal v1.8 has a client-side sanitizer that strips characters after a hash (#). If user pasted "Order#12345" the field ended up empty after our trim regex. Backend stored metadata blank; charge itself succeeded.
marta (billing): For captured charges our standard is: create credit memo, refund remote capture, create corrected invoice with proper order_ref, then rebill (if customer wants). This avoids mismatched ledger entries. Note: refunds affect settlement timings.
priya (customer-success): Customer prefers to avoid a visible refund on their side if possible; asked whether we can issue a credit memo and apply it to a corrected invoice so the net looks identical.
alex (support): Proposed options for customer: 1) Admin PATCH invoice metadata, regenerate PDF, resend (fast, but original invoice number stays on payments). 2) Full credit + reissue + rebill (clean accounting, slower settlement). Which do we recommend?
marta (billing): Accounting preference = credit + reissue for audit trail. We must also re-run VAT/tax calc on the corrected invoice to ensure tax lines match; otherwise tax reclaim could break.
ryan (engineering): Long term we'll fix sanitizer in portal. Short term we can add order_ref into invoice metadata via admin API: PATCH /admin/invoices/INV-2026-0042 { order_ref: "Order#12345" } then regenerate PDF. That won't touch payments. If you need the payment tied to a new invoice, follow billing's credit/reissue path.
alex (support): I'll confirm with ThermoTech which they want. If they pick credit/reissue, billing: can you paste the exact playbook steps here so ops can run it?
marta (billing): Playbook (summary): 1) Create Credit Memo tied to INV-2026-0042 with reason "missing order id". 2) Issue refund to processor for charge pay_3K7b2c (full refund). 3) Create new invoice INV-2026-0042-R1 with order_ref metadata set and same line items; ensure VAT calculated. 4) Attempt rebill against stored payment token (token id tok_cust_9), if token fails notify customer for new card. 5) Mark ledger entries and add ACCT case ref ACCT-2219. Settlement ETA 2-3 business days. I'll attach the internal script snippet. :paperclip:

alex (support): FYI I'll add an audit note and flag engineering for the sanitizer fix. Also adding the ACCT-2219 ref to the case.
bot-invoice: automated: Invoice INV-2026-0042 metadata updated by alex (support) at 2026-03-16T15:02:00Z (previous order_ref=null)
priya (customer-success): ThermoTech confirmed they want credit memo + rebill, they accept refund settlement window. Please proceed.
marta (billing): Starting the playbook now, will update when refund initiated and when new invoice created.
alex (support): Thanks team. Keeping customer looped.
